Interactive installations built for a space and handed over, with support after.
Do visitors need to wear anything?
No. Cameras and sensors follow people without anything worn. Badges or tagged objects are only needed for RFID and NFC triggers.
What do you build interactive content in?
TouchDesigner, with 3D models and real-time content made in house for the space.
Can you rent a motion capture system?
Yes. Motion capture and tracking systems are rented, installed, calibrated and run by our technicians, for a live show, an install or a capture session.
Can motion capture drive visuals live?
Yes. The capture data streams into real-time 3D and TouchDesigner content, so a character or a visual moves with the performer on screen. It can also be recorded for later use.
Yes. We design and install it for the space, hand it over, and support it after.
Do you work outside New York?
Yes. We are based in Brooklyn, New York, and the same crew travels with the equipment.
Start with what you need and when.
Tell us where, when, how many people and what has to happen. We reply with one quote for equipment, crew and delivery.
